evidence: Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree unit test framework and assertion system in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}.
rationale: Replaces the external unit test framework with an in-tree framework featuring expression decomposition on failure. This addresses long-standing goals (issue #8670, RFC #34666) to remove Boost.Test reliance and unblock future unit test runner enhancements such as concurrency.
